svg.title: Ontario presence and absence clocks for a snowbird year
svg.desc: A 365-day line marked at 153 days of required Ontario presence and at about 212 days away, the seven-month line that needs a ServiceOntario visit before departure.
svg.text: Ontario clocks, not a travel policy
Ministry pages used 24 Sep 2026. B.C. and Alberta use different tests.
Room to be away inside a 12-month period
About 212 days away = the seven-month line
More than seven months outside Canada: ServiceOntario before you leave, valid card,
Ontario still home, and 153 days in each of the two prior 12-month periods.
B.C.: six months in the calendar year, vacation absence up to seven months. Call HIBC at six months.
Alberta: 183 days in any 12-month period. Recurring vacation up to 212 days means contact AHCIP first.
A private policy that requires provincial eligibility fails if this clock fails.
Bars are day counts, not dollars. Public hospital caps are a different chart on the provincial guide.
